cards.title: Multimode Wigner and characteristic conventions
cards.role: Fixes every normalization, Fourier convention, and parity sign used downstream.

checks.reason: Both definitions are printed in the main text.
The convention gives W_0(alpha)=2 exp(-2|alpha|^2)/pi with unit phase-space integral and chi_0(xi)=exp(-|xi|^2/2).

cards.numerical_form: Use one complex coordinate as two real quadratures; a vacuum factor at the origin equals 2/pi.

cards.title: Collective coordinates and the equal-coordinate slice
cards.role: Turns the paper's correlated two-dimensional slice into a one-mode center-of-mass coordinate with relative modes fixed at the origin.

checks.reason: The collective coordinates and equal-coordinate identity are printed in the End Matter and Supplemental S1.
The three coefficient vectors are mutually orthonormal, so they preserve the canonical commutators and the phase-space norm.

cards.numerical_form: gamma=sqrt(3)*alpha on the equal slice; use (alpha_plus, alpha_minus, alpha_perp) for the Fig. 1 cut.

cards.title: Slice negativity and the state-dependent GME bound
cards.role: Defines the first theorem's quantitative witness and the two integrals that must be evaluated for Fig. 1.

checks.reason: Both quantities are printed in Theorem 1.
Supplemental S1 gives |integral W|<=M^{-1}(2/pi)^{M-1}, which makes the stated GME threshold finite and nonnegative.

cards.numerical_form: Integrate the negative part and signed function in polar coordinates; certify only when N2D exceeds the state-dependent bound.

cards.title: Smoothed center-of-mass negativity witness
cards.role: Defines the second theorem's convolution and explains why a surviving negative value certifies GME.

checks.reason: The convolution and trace-distance inequality are printed in Theorem 2.
For every non-GME state the right-hand distance can vanish at sigma=rho, forcing the smoothed function to be nonnegative.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate a two-dimensional convolution or its analytic Fock-diagonal reduction; any negative result is the witness.

cards.title: Minimum-width Gaussian kernel for three modes
cards.role: Specializes the allowed Gaussian smoothing family to the kernel used in the Fig. 1 example.

checks.reason: The End Matter states this kernel, and it saturates the determinant constraint in the Gaussian-filter equation.
Direct polar integration gives (8/pi)*(pi/6)=4/3; the theorem's kernel is not a probability-normalized blur.

cards.title: Finite-region absolute-volume GME criterion
cards.role: Turns a bounded set of Wigner measurements into the operational criterion shown in Fig. 2(a).

checks.reason: The definition and sufficient threshold are printed in the finite-region corollary.
The proof uses V_omega<=the full absolute integral and subtracts the signed-integral bound from Supplemental S1 to recover Theorem 1.

cards.numerical_form: For M=3 compare the disk integral against 1/(2*sqrt(2)).

cards.title: Tripartite W-state Wigner slice
cards.role: Provides the exact field plotted in Fig. 2(a).

checks.reason: The full vector expression is printed in the End Matter.
The W state is one center-of-mass excitation with both relative modes in vacuum; multiplying W_1(sqrt(3)alpha) by two vacuum-origin factors gives the stated slice.
The sign changes at |alpha|=1/(2*sqrt(3)), matching the central negative disk and positive annulus in the source panel.

cards.title: Closed-form W-state disk volume
cards.role: Allows Fig. 2(a)'s finite-region statement to be checked without relying on image pixels or grid quadrature.

checks.reason: The piecewise result is printed in the End Matter.
Writing d^2alpha=2*pi*r dr and splitting the absolute value at r=1/(2*sqrt(3)) gives both branches and a continuous join.

cards.numerical_form: Use the analytic branch rather than discretizing the disk.

cards.title: Exact finite-disk threshold radius
cards.role: Replaces the caption's rounded r approximately 0.7 statement with the independently solved crossing.

checks.reason: The paper draws r=0.7 and states that radii around or above 0.7 certify GME.
High-precision root finding on the second analytic branch gives 0.699195329344; substituting r=0.7 exceeds 1/(2*sqrt(2)) by 5.82084e-4.

cards.title: Finite characteristic-function GME matrix
cards.role: Defines the finite-point Bochner witness behind Fig. 2(b).

checks.reason: The corollary prints C, K, the Hadamard product, and the minimum-eigenvalue witness.
chi(-xi)=chi(xi)* makes both matrices Hermitian; the Schur product therefore has a real eigenspectrum.

cards.numerical_form: Construct the 7x7 Hermitian matrix from pairwise complex-coordinate differences and use eigvalsh.

cards.title: W-state characteristic slice and seven-point witness
cards.role: Provides the exact heat map, point set, and matrix entries used to reproduce Fig. 2(b).

checks.reason: The characteristic function, Xi, and xi0 are printed in the main text and End Matter.
One center-of-mass excitation gives chi_1(sqrt(3)xi)=(1-3|xi|^2)exp(-3|xi|^2/2).
With a vacuum filter, direct diagonalization gives lambda_min=-0.017580375648 and the remaining six eigenvalues positive, reproducing 0.0176.

cards.title: Illustrative state in collective Fock modes
cards.role: Defines every coefficient needed for the numerical surfaces in Fig. 1.

checks.reason: The creation-operator state is printed in the End Matter.
Applying (a_dagger^n)/sqrt(n!) to vacuum gives normalized |n>, yielding exactly the six stated collective-basis amplitudes.
The squared weights are 2/50+38/50+2/10=1.

cards.numerical_form: Sparse amplitudes: (1,0),(3,0)=1/(5sqrt2); (1,1),(3,1)=sqrt19/(5sqrt2); (2,2),(4,2)=1/sqrt10; third relative mode is vacuum.

cards.title: Illustrative slice parity integral and corrected GME threshold
cards.role: Checks the Fig. 1 theorem-1 claim directly from the printed state and exposes a four-unit numerator inconsistency in the source.

checks.reason: The source prints the state, the collective-slice identity, and a threshold numerator of 56.
Grouping the normalized state's probabilities by relative Fock parity gives -13/25; Supplemental S1 then fixes the signed integral and produces numerator 52, not 56.
Independent polar quadrature gives N2D approximately 0.263699, above the corrected 0.263443 bound but below the printed 0.270110 bound.

cards.numerical_form: Report both the source-printed and state-derived thresholds; acceptance of the state witness uses only the state-derived value and carries a source_inconsistency flag.
open_questions: The End Matter's numerator 56 is incompatible with the normalized state printed immediately above it. No alternate state coefficient or convention that produces 56 is supplied.

cards.title: Reduced center-of-mass state and exact smoothed value

source_refs.value: resulting function yields the negative value

cards.role: Independently derives the exact theorem-2 witness value quoted for Fig. 1.

checks.reason: The End Matter prints the kernel and -7/(16*pi) value.
The reduced density matrix has trace 0.4*2+0.1*2=1.
Angular integration removes off-diagonal Fock terms; Laguerre integration gives (-1)^n 2^(1-n)/pi, and the four diagonal populations sum to -7/(16*pi).

cards.title: Discrete Wigner sampling counts

source_refs.value: arXiv:2510.26762, Sec. numerical integration, Fig. Wstate_discrete

cards.role: Recomputes the approximately 76000 and approximately 78 phase-space point counts from printed radii and grid spacings.

checks.reason: The companion paper prints both radii, both grid spacings, and the approximate point counts.
r=0.9 and Delta=0.0058 give approximately 7.56e4 cells, rounding to 76000.
r=1 and Delta=0.2 give pi/0.04 approximately 78.54 points, consistent with the paper's approximate count.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate pi*r^2/Delta^2 directly from the companion paper parameters.

cards.title: All-finite-mode detected families

source_refs.value: arXiv:2510.26762, states generated via vacuum interference

cards.role: Constructs explicit theorem-1 Fock inputs and theorem-2 W states for each tested mode count.

checks.reason: The companion paper states both multiport constructions and the eta<1/M lossy-W criterion.
Root-split Laguerre quadrature finds a positive theorem-1 margin for every M=3..12.
The theorem-2 lossy-W lower bound is positive whenever eta<1/M.

cards.numerical_form: Search n<=32 for each M=3..12 using independent absolute-Wigner quadrature; evaluate the exact W-family bound.
open_questions: Finite numerical checks support but do not replace fresh proof review of the all-finite-M quantifier.

cards.title: Mode-count robustness law

source_refs.value: arXiv:2510.26762, robustness in the presence of noise

cards.role: Makes the decreasing-robustness statement executable without importing plotted data.

checks.reason: The companion robustness section prints the exact loss condition eta<1/M and states decreasing robustness.
The exact loss threshold 1/M is strictly decreasing for positive M.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate eta_max for M=3..12 and assert strict decrease.
